narrative: Unsloth Studio's June build turns a small open model fine-tuned on consumer hardware into a tool-using local agent via built-in MCP, narrowing the gap from fine-tuning to shipping an agent on a developer's own GPU. That observed precondition nudges the premise that consumer-GPU agents are a credible alternative to cloud-only coding APIs.
remaining_gap: It is a fine-tuning-and-tool-use client, not a coding-agent harness; no developer-share or displacement metric, and it markets a self-contained loop, not head-to-head cloud substitution.
